# PROFILE REVIEW EXERCISE
The fictional profile review desk is called Amber Desk. The demo confirmation badge reads
PROFILE-PREVIEW-ONLY. It does not verify identity or approve a real account.
The review worksheet asks the participant to compare the displayed profile with the practice
record, note any mismatched labels, and return to the Profile card. The worksheet is a local
teaching artifact rather than a submission to an identity provider. No personal documents are
required to complete this fictional worksheet.
The worksheet contains three distinct boxes: Display check, Label check, and Completion check.
Display check records whether the Profile card is visible. Label check records whether the
practice reference matches the page. Completion check records that the participant has read the
exercise. These boxes describe a paper exercise and do not represent backend KYC approval
states.

the worksheet without changing an account. Returning to the exercise begins with the same
